name: Sahi Hamada
source:
Sahi is a fierce warrior and a master tactician, but his talent in battle belies a gentle soul, and he believes that war with Andromeda is dangerous and unnecessary. Sahi was orphaned in the Canis civil war and came to Lauté alone. He joined the King’s army and grew up training alongside you. You became fast friends, and it wasn’t long before Sahi realized he wanted something more. With his new title of General, he is finally of the proper standing to be an eligible Match for you. Will he have the courage to speak up about his feelings?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/harlevin/celestial-crowns-relaunch-an-18-fantasy-visual-novel/]Kickstarter[/url]]
